loopClosure.method: Append the real source first key at sourceDuration + one native 24fps step. Standard KeyframeTrack data and official retargetClip perform playback and baking.
loopClosure.bakedEndpoint: Exact baked first-key values replace the baked closing endpoint to remove official retargetClip last-sample epsilon.
loopClosure.continuityClaim: C0 pose closure only; C1 velocity continuity is not claimed.
